text: sajjhāyasuttaṃ [786] ekaṃ samayaṃ aññataro bhikkhu kosalesu viharati aññatarasmiṃ vanasaṇḍe . tena kho pana samayena so bhikkhu yaṃ sudaṃ pubbe ativelaṃ sajjhāyabahulo viharati . so aparena samayena appossukko tuṇhībhūto sakamāyati 2 . [787] atha kho yā tasmiṃ vanasaṇḍe adhivatthā devatā tassa bhikkhuno dhammaṃ asuṇantī yena so bhikkhu tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā #1 ma. apaviddhaṃva . 2 ma. yu. saṅkasāyati . taṃ bhikkhuṃ gāthāya ajjhabhāsi kasmā tuvaṃ dhammapadāni bhikkhu nādhīyasi 1 bhikkhūhi saṃvasanto sutvāna dhammaṃ labhatippasādaṃ diṭṭheva dhamme labhatippasaṃsanti . [788] ahu pure dhammapadesu chando yāva virāgena samāgamimha yato virāgena samāgamimha yaṅkiñci diṭṭhaṃva sutaṃ mutaṃ vā aññāya nikkhepanamāhu santoti . ekādasamaṃ ayonisomanasikārasuttaṃ [789]
